summary: Iteration 2 deep regression: backend 20/20 pytest passed (auth, ingredients CRUD+filters, formulas CRUD, duplicate, duplicate?as_version=true, validation, 401/404 guards). Frontend: login, dashboard seeded data + note balance + tabs, ingredient search/note-filter/add-material end-to-end, calculator live math (100g@18% -> 18.00g oil / 82.00g alcohol, recalc on 250g), IFRA red warning on Bergamot row (2.00% vs 0.40%) + safety panel failure, live recalc on weight edit (3.60%), picker add material, save, lab sheet modal with per-material IFRA status, CSV download (velvet-cedar-lab-sheet.csv), PDF print window opens, duplicate -> 'Velvet Cedar Copy' v1.0, new version -> title unchanged v1.1, and full draft caching flow (unsaved draft card, resume restores with banner, save clears draft) all PASS. Three real bugs found: sign-out broken on web (Alert.alert no-op), theme toggle no-op (Appearance.setColorScheme unsupported on RN-web + stored theme never read at boot), share button throws uncaught red-screen error 'Share is not supported in this browser'.

ui_bugs.issue: Sign-out confirm never renders on web: Alert.alert is a no-op on react-native-web, so signOut() is unreachable and the button appears dead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:40

formula-share-button triggers UNCAUGHT error 'Share is not supported in this browser' (Expo red error overlay in dev, unhandled rejection in prod) because shareFormula has no try/catch and navigator.share is unavailable. Reference: /app/frontend/app/formula/[id].tsx:229

settings-theme-toggle does nothing: theme.ts setColorScheme calls Appearance.setColorScheme which is a no-op on react-native-web (useColorScheme only follows prefers-color-scheme); additionally THEME_KEY 'aromaform_theme' is written but never read at app boot, so persistence is broken too. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts:63-71, /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:41-45

integration_issues.issue: Cannot complete sign-out on web preview due to Alert.alert no-op (see ui_bugs)
router.replace empties the back stack; pressing formula-back-button logs 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' (dev warning, no visual break, fallback to dashboard worked)

issues: Category/note chips sit below the fold inside the pageSheet modal on small mobile screens; modal content requires scrolling before chips are reachable (RN Modal on web renders inline rather than as a fixed overlay, so underlying list content remains visible above the modal while scrolled). Functional but worth a maxHeight/overlay fix.

action_items: Fix sign-out on web: replace Alert.alert in settings.tsx with a cross-platform confirm (RN Modal or Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.confirm : Alert.alert) so settings-signout-button actually signs out.
Fix theme toggle: replace Appearance.setColorScheme with React state/context override in theme.ts and hydrate scheme from stored 'aromaform_theme' key at boot (currently written but never read).
Fix share crash: wrap shareFormula in try/catch and fall back to clipboard copy on web when navigator.share is unavailable ([id].tsx:229).
Optional: after duplicate/new-version use router.dismissTo or push instead of replace to avoid the unhandled GO_BACK warning.
Optional: make web Modals render as fixed overlays (or constrain height) so modal chips are reachable without scrolling past underlying content.

Clean up test data left in DB: ingredients TEST Vetiver / TEST_Orris_*, formulas TEST_Formula_b8c8e4, TEST Draft Noir, Velvet Cedar Copy (x2), Velvet Cedar v1.1 (edited during tests: Bergamot 2g + TEST Vetiver added), Velvet Cedar Copy v1.1. Original seeded Velvet Cedar v1.0 = formula_2db549afe2c3 untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: Alert.alert (settings.tsx:40) and unguarded Share.share ([id].tsx:229) are react-native-web incompatibilities - both fail at runtime on the web preview.
theme.ts has no state management: setColorScheme relies on Appearance API that RN-web ignores, and the persisted theme key is never read back - theme feature is effectively dead on web.
api.ts uses same-origin on web + EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL on native - matches the contract from iteration 1; no hardcoded URLs found.
MongoDB _id properly excluded from all API responses; Pydantic validation present; auth guards on all protected routes verified with 401s.
All interactive elements now carry kebab-case testIDs - iteration 1 testability gap is fully resolved.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (32/36 checks; 3 confirmed product bugs: sign-out, theme toggle, share)

On web, RN Modal renders inline (scrollIntoView before clicking modal chips); dashboard cards need scrollIntoView-safe clicking or direct URL navigation after login (token persists in localStorage). CSV export closes the lab-sheet modal on web by design - reopen for PDF test. After router.replace (duplicate/new version), formula-back-button has no back entry - fallback: page.goto(base).
rca_of_issue: 1) Sign-out dead on web: react-native-web does not implement Alert.alert; confirmSignOut never invokes signOut. Fix: platform-aware confirm. 2) Theme toggle dead: theme.ts setColorScheme -> Appearance.setColorScheme is a no-op on RN-web; useColorScheme only tracks prefers-color-scheme; stored THEME_KEY never hydrated. Fix: context state + boot-time storage read. 3) Share crash: Share.share unsupported in headless/desktop browsers without navigator.share; missing try/catch produces Expo uncaught-error overlay. Fix: try/catch + clipboard fallback.
